comments.issue: test_failed_dispatch_stamp_releases_reservation never creates a reservation before dispatch() runs (self.task() only calls bus.create_task; stamp() gates dispatch() before executor.start/pool.reserve can ever run). The assertNotIn(tid, live_reservations()) is vacuously true regardless of any release logic, so the test doesn't actually exercise a release-on-failed-stamp path despite its name — it only proves a failed stamp skips dispatch entirely, which self.started==[] already covers.
